newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani rupee dips in kerb, seen falling.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani rupee dips in kerb, seen falling.

text.p: The Pakistani rupee dipped 0.05 to 41.00 to the dollar in the kerb market on Tuesday on higher demand of the U.S. currency from investors and traders, dealers said.
They said the rupee was likely to open lower on Wednesday on higher demand for the dollar and its short supplies from abroad.
The State (central) Bank of Pakistan rate, last changed on September 10, was 36.9700/37.1549 rupees to the dollar.
The premium on foreign exchange bearer certificates closed unchanged at 10.80 percent. -- Ibrahim Khan 9221-5685192
